product.title: Yellow Semi-Submarine Tour of Catalina Island From Avalon

description.text: Board a semi-submersible in Avalon for a short undersea cruise through Lovers' Cove where you can watch fish schools and reef habitat through large viewing ports while staying dry. The return leg surfaces for open-air island views, making this an easy marine-life outing for families and first-time visitors to Catalina.

highlights: See marine life around Lovers' Cove without getting wet
Frequent departure times make same-day planning easy

start.description: Green Pleasure Pier, Avalon, CA 90704, USA. Check in at the booth at the end of the pier.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
Travel to Catalina Island is not included in the ticket price
Bring cash if you want to purchase fish food during the tour
